blocks.title: See it *live*
blocks.text: Open the demo on your phone, press the RSVP, scroll the whole thing. It is the template exactly as you will receive it.

steps.title: Buy the template
steps.text: Pay by card or Apple Pay. Your Canva link and setup guide appear straight after checkout and land in your inbox.

steps.title: Open it in Canva
steps.text: One click makes your own editable copy. A free Canva account is all you need.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.text: Swap names, dates, venue and photos. Every colour and font is already set.

steps.title: Publish and share
steps.text: Canva gives you a live link. Send it with your invitations and watch the RSVPs come in.
